digest.component_or_area: CI workflows and Git fetch mechanisms
propositions: Add filter: blob:none to actions/checkout@v7 steps in reconcile-bridge.yml, verify-identity.yml, and reconcile-bridge-canary.yml while preserving fetch-depth: 0 and existing credential/ref settings.
Add explicit --filter=blob:none to both tickets fetches in gerrit-verify.yaml: depth-1 require-ticket fetch and full-history verify-identity fetch.

Implement production guards that parse git count-objects -v pack size immediately after checkout/materialization and fail if size exceeds REBAR_CHECKOUT_PACK_LIMIT_KIB (102400) or REBAR_TICKETS_PACK_LIMIT_KIB (131072).

Create real-Git test fixture using git daemon with filter capability, GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL, and packet-trace validation to prove server advertises filter support and client sends filter blob:none requests.

Verify blobless checkouts reduce pack sizes from baseline measurements: standalone from 1.04 GiB to 68.7 MiB and Gerrit from 6.73 minutes with 1.4 GB full fetch to 22 MB with blob:none plus materialization.
Ensure workflow materialization does not add objects beyond initial checkout, validated by exact before/after git count-objects -v snapshot comparison in both standalone and Gerrit identity jobs.
